runtime.runtime_mode: Plain JVM, actual framework Color primitive methods; no fake APIs or shadows

scope: Bounded enum and scalar Double semantics, original GotoTab and TextColorUtil. TextColorUtil runs real AndroidX core1.17.0 and Android14 android-all primitive graphics implementations on a plain JDK with verification; no Android device, Robolectric runner/shadows, full application, or performance claim. Java reflects GotoTab because its package segment goto is a Java keyword. ReadingGuide is a separately assessed stretch target with real original dependency sources and selected original resources generated by aapt2; Preferences.selected() and Android application lifecycle are not exercised.
